The '''sky elevator''' was an [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] in [[Xizor's Palace]] that connected [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] estate to the ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. It was destroyed in the destruction of the palace.
